title: Marigold Fintech — Security Questionnaire Responses & Evidence Index (Dedicated POC)
content:
Executive summary:

This document bundles Redwood's formal responses to Marigold Fintech's security questionnaire for the Dedicated POC, plus a mapped index of attachments/evidence that support each answer. Purpose is twofold: (1) provide a readable Q&A that their InfoSec review team can consume, and (2) give our internal reviewers a checklist of deliverables we must attach before the next SOW sign-off.

Status & scope:
- POC type: Dedicated (reserved capacity) deployed into Marigold’s AWS account via Private deployment (VPC peering).
- Main security focuses from Marigold: encryption at rest/in transit, key lifecycle & HSM usage, data residency, personnel access controls, audit logs retention, and model governance (control plane separation).
- This file is a living index: we are still collecting one piece of evidence (KMS policy snapshot for their cross-account role).

Notes to reviewers (internal):
- The tone of the responses is deliberately conservative; where a customer asks for attestation we avoid promises beyond current SLA or managed features.
- Call out any requested SRE/infra changes as potential billable items in the next SOW.
- See linked JIRA ticket JIRA-POC-4123 for action items assigned to eng/infra.

Questionnaire - condensed Q&A (select questions and our responses):

Q1: How is customer data encrypted at rest?
A1: All persisted customer data in Redwood Dedicated nodes is encrypted using AES-256. In hosted ops we use provider-managed disk encryption, for Private/VPC deployments we enable customer-managed KMS keys by default. See evidence item E01-E03.

Q2: How are keys stored and who has access?
A2: Production encryption keys can be customer-managed in AWS KMS or our supported HSM integrations. Redwood personnel do not hold plaintext keys. Key policies and IAM roles required for cross-account access are documented in E04.

Q3: Can we enforce network isolation and restrict egress?
A3: Yes. For the Dedicated POC we configure the workload in the customer's VPC with strict security groups and optional egress NAT restrictions. E05 contains the VPC diagram and proposed NACLs.

Q4: What logging and audit trails are available?
A4: We expose audit logs for control-plane actions and inference requests metadata (no prompt storage unless enabled). Logs are forwarded to the customer's CloudWatch/Logging endpoint via an encrypted delivery channel; retention meets the baseline 90 days for the POC and can be extended. See E06 and E07.

Q5: How do you handle third-party dependencies and supply chain?
A5: We maintain SBOMs for production images and a vulnerability scanning cadence. SBOM summaries and the most recent scan results are in E08.

Evidence index (attachment filename -> short description -> questionnaire refs):
- E01_network-diagram-marigold-vpc.pdf -> Diagram: VPC peering architecture, subnets, NAT/Gateway placement -> refs Q3
- E02_disk-encryption-config-snippet.txt -> Terraform snippet demonstrating AES-256 disk encryption enabled on provisioned volumes -> refs Q1
- E03_storage-kms-policy-export.json -> KMS key policy exported from the staging account (redacted) -> refs Q1,Q2
- E04_cross-account-iam-role-and-kms-attachment.pdf -> Roles and trust relationships required for Redwood to access customer-shared key (template) -> refs Q2
- E05_security-groups-and-nacl-proposal.md -> Proposed security groups and egress deny list for the POC -> refs Q3
- E06_audit-log-architecture-and-sample-logs.zip -> Explanation plus 2-day sample of obfuscated control plane logs -> refs Q4
- E07_log-forwarding-config-cloudwatch-to-s3.txt -> Step-by-step for forwarding logs to customer's S3 with encryption -> refs Q4
- E08_sbom-and-scan-summary-2026-01-30.pdf -> SBOM extract and vulnerability scan results with triage notes -> refs Q5
- E09_access-review-export-marigold.csv -> Access review output for users/groups with access to the Dedicated environment (redacted) -> refs Q2
- E10_hsm-integration-design-notes.md -> Optional design notes for using customer HSM/HSM-as-a-service -> refs Q2

Attachments currently pending or action items:
- E03 (full KMS policy) — pending full redaction approval from Marigold security (owner: Lena Cho).
- E06 (complete 30-day logs) — currently limited export; SRE will provide full export on 2026-02-22 (JIRA-POC-4123 #sre-export).

Workshop notes (onsite technical sync, 2026-02-04):
- Attendees: Marigold infra/security, Redwood SEs (Asha, Diego), Redwood SRE lead (Noah).
- Marigold clarified: no customer prompt retention during POC; they only need inference metadata. We confirmed feature flagging for prompt-storage disabled by default.
- Action: provide a short runbook for enabling/disabling prompt retention (owner: Diego, due 2026-02-12).
- Discussed fallback modes: if customer-managed KMS is unavailable, automatic fallback to Redwood-managed key must be explicitly approved in writing. Marigold asked for a fallback playbook — assigned to product/infra.
- Network cutover plan: agreed on two-phase testing window (connectivity smoke test, traffic shaping).

Open questions for Marigold security: (for follow-up email)
1) Confirm the required retention period for audit logs beyond the baseline 90 days (they flagged 365 days in a side comment).
2) Provide the canonical list of users who should be part of the initial access review (we have a CSV draft, see E09).
3) Approve the attached cross-account role template (E04) or provide your internal equivalent.

Risk notes (internal):
- If Marigold requires HSM-backed keys with in-house key material (BYOK), schedule and cost will increase; provide a written estimate before acceptance.
- Any request for longer retention of raw prompts changes data residency obligations and may trigger legal review.

Next steps and ownership:
- Asha: finalize this document and send to Marigold security with E01-E02-E04 attached by 2026-02-18.
- Lena: obtain redaction approval and release E03 by 2026-02-20.
- Noah/SRE: full audit log export and operational checklist by 2026-02-22 (JIRA-POC-4123 #sre-export).
- Diego: prompt retention runbook and feature-flag instructions by 2026-02-12.

Appendix - quick references:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/POC/Marigold-Dedicated-POC
- JIRA board: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-POC-4123
- Slack thread: #marigold-poc (look for thread TS-jan-sesh)

Internal reviewer checklist (quick):
- [ ] Attach final redacted KMS policy (E03)
- [ ] Confirm customer signature on fallback to Redwood-managed key if needed
- [ ] Make sure runbook link included in E07 delivery notes
- [ ] Confirm legal has seen prompt-retention impact note

End of document.
